summary: Frontend-only testing of the reformed OrçaNext landing page (/). Verified header, hero, mockup content, problem/transformation/how-it-works/benefits/for-service-providers/social-proof/result sections, pricing toggle (monthly/yearly), mid + final CTAs, FAQ accordion (14 items), footer, SEO/OG metas, responsive behavior on 320/375/390/414/768/1024/1440, mobile menu open/close, no fake testimonials, and no external face image requests. Regression on /login, /register, /forgot-password OK.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx is ~855 lines; consider splitting sections into /components/landing/* modules for maintainability.

Global AuthContext appears to call /api/auth/me on public landing route, producing 3 x 401 in console (non-blocking, but noisy for anonymous visitors). Consider suppressing the /me probe or lowering log level on public routes.
OG url is 'https://orcanext.com' (no trailing slash) while canonical uses 'https://orcanext.com/'. Minor inconsistency; normalize.
og:image points to /logo.png (32x32 favicon-sized). For proper social previews use a 1200x630 OG image.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing rewrite verified end-to-end at https://invoice-pro-435.preview.emergentagent.com/. All required data-testids present and CTAs route correctly. Pricing toggle changes R$ 49,90 <-> R$ 39,90 with proper secondary line. FAQ has 14 items, first item opens (data-state=open). No horizontal scroll on any tested viewport. No banned testimonial names (Marina Rocha, Carla Duarte) and no external face images loaded.
